title: harness.json
description: Per-project contract for the harness plugin, committed at <project>/.claude/harness.json. Every key is optional; plugins/harness/config/defaults.json fills the rest. Objects merge key by key; arrays and scalars replace.

harness_version.description: Plugin VERSION the pinned schema copy was synced from.

base_branch.description: PR base branch; null resolves origin/HEAD, else main.

integration_branches.description: Branches d-w fetches from origin before cutting; empty means [base_branch, main].

skills_dir.description: Where this project keeps its own skills (review lens detection).

schemas_dir.description: Pinned schema copy; resolved before the plugin's schemas/.

state_dir.description: Runtime state (sentinels, pr-team runtime). Gitignore it.

matrix_path.description: pr-review invocation test matrix JSONL (repo data).

exclusions.description: Machine-generated exclusions JSON; null disables exclusion filtering.

file_pattern.description: Regex a repo-relative POSIX path must match to count as a test file.

registry.description: Test registry JSON; null means none.

registry_names.description: File names that count as registry files for review bucketing.

timings.description: Test timing report JSON: rows under tests with file (repo-relative) and duration (seconds), summed per file; a row's file must equal the registry entry's file exactly (same characters, forward slashes, no ./ prefix, no ::nodeid suffix) or its time is not matched; null means none.

fixer_test_seconds.description: pr-review fixers defer a registered test whose summed timings exceed this many seconds; null disables the runtime rule.

defer_flags.description: Dotted paths into a registry entry (e.g. properties.super_slow); a test whose value at any of them is true is deferred out of fixer runs.

local_test_pattern.description: Touched paths matching this regex add local_guards to the structural guard run.

lenses.description: Project lens catalog merged over the plugin's generic lenses.

pointer.description: Rule text added to a reviewer brief whose scope touches prefix.

commit_buckets.description: Ordered path rules for commit grouping; first match wins.

auto_approve_python_c.description: Auto-approve `python -c` Bash commands in this project.

worktree_root.description: Directory linked worktrees are created under; a leading ~ expands and {repo} is the main checkout's folder name. null: ~/.config/superpowers/worktrees/{repo}.

runlogs.description: Where the project's run logs (test-runner or script console output) land; read by check-runlogs.

dir.description: Run-log folder; subfolders at any depth (e.g. dated archive folders) are searched too. null: check-runlogs needs --dir.

name_pattern.description: Regex a log file name must fully match; named group date (YYYY-MM-DD) required (checked at config load), time (HHMMSS) optional, a date-only name sorts as midnight.
